QUOTE: "`ResponseGenerator` observer | `dispatch_batch_generate` | Mirrors the engine interrupt flag into the C-ABI int" and "give the C ABI an atomic, which the code comments say was avoided to keep the boundary `int*`-only."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the observer thread mirrors the engine's interrupt flag into the plain C-ABI int, and that the boundary is kept `int*`-only so it cannot carry an atomic. That is the substance of the item.
